# k3d_registry (Resource)

A k3d container registry. Every change replaces the registry, and images stored in it are lost unless `volumes` persists them. Create it before the clusters that use it by passing `ref` to `k3d_cluster.registries.use`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "k3d_registry" "cache" {
  name = "cache"
  port = 5000

  proxy = {
    remote_url = "https://registry-1.docker.io"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Registry name, without the `k3d-` prefix.
- `port` (Number) Port on the Docker host.

### Optional

- `delete_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the registry allows deleting images.
- `host_ip` (String) Host IP to bind. Defaults to all interfaces.
- `image` (String) Registry image with a pinned tag or digest.
- `network` (String) Docker network to join when created. Clusters that use the registry connect it to their own network.
- `proxy` (Attributes) Runs the registry as a pull-through cache. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy))
- `volumes` (List of String) Volumes for the registry, such as `/data/registry:/var/lib/registry`. Sources are on the Docker host.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The registry name.
- `node_name` (String) Name of the registry container, with the `k3d-` prefix.
- `ref` (String) Reference for `k3d_cluster.registries.use`.

<a id="nestedatt--proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy`

Required:

- `remote_url` (String) URL of the upstream registry.

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Upstream password. Docker stores it in the container environment.
- `username` (String) Upstream username.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import k3d_registry.cache cache
```
